summary.text: Chanel Mosley is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 75, an office she has held since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Chanel Mosley assumed office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Alan Gray.
She won the 2024 general election with no opposition and defeated Chris Brown in the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Consent and House Procedure Committee and the House Ways and Means Committee.
